name: work-panel
title: Card and dark panel
description: A card beside the dark panel in the website's double rule: the title with its red full stop, one line and the one action; on the panel the grain, a sheet of cells and one small window that plays once.
use_for: A page whose job is one action with a visible result: Getting started, Agents, Send by API.
never: Two dark panels on one page
A window that replays on hover: it plays once
More than one dark button in the card
body:
Put one window in the `window` slot: one of the website's product windows (`step-viz`, `eval-viz`, `product-viz`,
`price-viz`) as Getting started does, or `WorkWindow`, the console's own small dark window (a bar with its title and a
tag, the body, a foot line whose square turns red when the work is done), for work the app runs itself.

examples.name: Product
examples.label: In the product
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import PixelButton from '@/components/ui/PixelButton.vue'
import WorkPanel from '@/components/product/WorkPanel.vue'
import StepViz from '@/components/visuals/StepViz.vue'
// A card with its one action, and the dark panel with a window beside it: How it works' search step (step-viz), which
// plays once as it renders.
const RUNS = [0, 0, 0, 0]
</script>

<template>
  <WorkPanel title="Run a search" line="Ask your data a question. Conare finds the passages that answer it." label="an example" tall>
    <PixelButton large>Run a search</PixelButton>
    <template #window>
      <StepViz :step="2" :runs="RUNS" active />
    </template>
  </WorkPanel>
</template>
